import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.games import make_game
from makemarket.provenance import receipt, file_sha256

root=Path('results/expansion'); label='meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct (text-only)'
plan_path=root/'llama_duplicate_retry_plan.json'; plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text());assert plan['status']=='finished'
cohorts={}
for game in ('dice','cards'):
 p=root/f'raw/{game}/meta_llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl'
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert sorted(r['seed'] for r in rows)==list(range(200,200+len(rows)))
 for row in rows:
  ep=make_game(game).episode(row['seed'])
  assert row['player']==label and row['value']==ep.value and len(row['rounds'])==6
  assert [r['reveal'] for r in row['rounds']]==ep.reveals
 protocol_path=root/f'protocol-llama90-{game}-duplicate-retry.json'; protocol=json.loads(protocol_path.read_text())[label][game]
 cohorts[game]={'episodes':len(rows),'planned_episodes':200,'scored':False,'file':str(p),'sha256':file_sha256(p),
  'canonical_games_verified':True,'terminal_error':protocol['error'],'protocol':str(protocol_path),'protocol_sha256':file_sha256(protocol_path)}
r={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Close optional Llama90 acquisition at preregistered cutoff without scoring partial cohorts'}),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'closed_partial_unscored','cutoff':plan['cutoff'],'finished_at':plan['finished_at'],
 'launch_receipt':str(plan_path),'launch_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),'cohorts':cohorts,
 'scope':'All four original APIs have 200/game and are scored. Llama90 dice173/cards92 and other optional partials do not enter any headline or API family comparison. No new calls after cutoff.'}
(root/'llama_duplicate_retry_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print({g:c['episodes'] for g,c in cohorts.items()})
cutoff: primary newest-family test acquisition completion or 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, whichever is earlier
